verse: For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
story: Paul closes his argument about slavery and freedom with a sentence built like a scale, with a wage on one side and a gift on the other.

Sin pays what it owes, and what it owes is death. That is the wage, earned and deserved. Eternal life is a different kind of thing entirely: the free gift of God, given in Christ Jesus our Lord. No one can work for it, and no one needs to. Paul has just said that we serve one master or another, and this verse shows what each master finally hands over.
You cannot earn what He is giving. Receive it today with open hands, and live as someone who has been set free.
